chunks: We shall punish those who deny Our revelations slowly in a way that they will not know.

key_terms.سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم: We shall gradually lead them on/punish them

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God will 'steer them on gradually' from where they do not know?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of *istidraj* (gradual enticement), where God grants respite to the disbelievers through increasing blessings or minor sins, masking their spiritual decline until they are caught unaware. This gradual process serves as a divine test, allowing their self-deception to solidify before the sudden onset of punishment. The verse underscores the irony that their lack of awareness is not merely ignorance but a consequence of their own rejection of divine signs.
